item.description: The socket path handling code does not validate for null bytes in path strings, causing ValueError exceptions when paths contain embedded null characters.
item.contract: Socket path handling functions must validate input paths to reject null bytes before attempting to use them in system calls. This applies to all socket creation, binding, and path-based operations for UNIX domain sockets.
item.acceptance: Tests that currently fail with "ValueError: embedded null byte in path" or "ValueError: stat: embedded null character in path" should pass after implementing null byte validation.

item.description: The test test_raise_baseexception_from_task fails because thread daemon property assertions are not properly implemented in the from_thread module.
item.contract: When a task is spawned from a blocking portal, it must properly inherit the daemon property of the thread it's executed on. Specifically, tasks started via from_thread.run should have their thread.daemon property checked to ensure it matches the expected behavior.
item.acceptance: Test test_raise_baseexception_from_task[asyncio] and test_raise_baseexception_from_task[trio] should pass after implementing proper daemon thread property handling.

item.description: The fast_acquire behavior in Lock and Semaphore classes is not correctly implemented, causing test failures in fast_acquire tests.
item.contract: The fast_acquire parameter in Lock and Semaphore constructors must correctly control whether to yield control to the event loop when acquiring the resource without contention. When fast_acquire=True, the acquisition should not yield control if there's no contention.
item.acceptance: Tests test_fast_acquire[asyncio] for Lock and test_fast_acquire[trio] for Lock, and similar semaphore tests should pass after implementing correct fast_acquire behavior.
